pair.invalid-url: The room address is not a valid URL.
pair.unsafe-room: {room} cannot receive this machine's credential: use HTTPS, or HTTP to loopback or a host in SIDEVOICE_TRUSTED_CLUSTER_HOSTS, without URL credentials.
pair.invalid-response: The room returned an invalid pairing response; the existing credential was left unchanged.
pair.success: Paired with {room} as connector {connector_id}; credential saved to {file}
pair.linked: Linked with {room} as connector {connector_id}; credential saved to {file}
pair-device.no-code: This machine's core answered without a pairing code.
pair-device.qr-failed: The device pairing code cannot be represented as a QR code.
pair-device.header: One-time code to pair a device with this machine{host}, valid for {validity}:
pair-device.paste: Paste it in the Sidevoice app under Machines → Pair.
pair-device.local-only: This code reaches this machine only from this computer. Pair the machine with a room or configure an address reachable from your device.
skill.usage: usage: sidevoice skill <remove|status> [--dir <skills dir>] (the MCP server now offers the voice-room prompt)
skill.foreign: {target} is not Sidevoice's skill; left as it is.
agents.list.empty: No supported agents were found on this computer.
agents.selection-invalid: The selected Sidevoice release record is unsafe or invalid.
agents.cleanup.codex-unavailable: Codex is unavailable, so its Sidevoice registration was left unchanged. Restore Codex and run `codex mcp remove sidevoice`, or inspect the Sidevoice table in {file} and remove only that entry.
agents.cleanup.claude-unavailable: Claude Code is unavailable, so its Sidevoice registration was left unchanged. Restore Claude Code and run `claude mcp remove --scope user sidevoice` in the same user configuration.
